partII.text: Pick Army Training before each of the first four Part II battles: floors Lv 34, 35, 37, 39
detail: Stats grow from the class a unit is in: set each late joiner's class first
[[class:Brigand]] Simon (Str) · [[class:Priest]] Dante (Res) · [[class:Shaman]] Olympia if she isn't Ovate yet (Mag)
[[class:Wing Soldier]] Catania (she flies in Ch 2) · [[class:Armored Ornius Rider]] Gaitz (Def)

partII.text: Spend Part II Advanced Licenses on Dante, Simon and Jester, plus Olympia or Goliath if they slipped
detail: 5 Specialty and 5 Advanced a chapter. Ch 1's floor is Lv 34, so anyone under Lv 35 goes in Ch 2
Jester's Ranger needs Oko beaten in Part I
Catania, Io, Ursula and Gaitz stay Specialty

partII.text: Ch 12 is your last shop: Part II has no free time, no shops and no recruiting
detail: Buy what you'll want for Part III's opening chapters while shops are open
Spend every Magic Echo Shard on Combat Art boosts

partII.text: Don't hoard weapons: Part II repairs every weapon each chapter and issues Iron +3 weapons
detail: Use Combat Arts freely in Ch 12, even if weapons break
The Pilum and Short Spears can wait for Part III

partII.text: Leave a slot free for Part II drops
detail: Ch 1: Goliath's [[item:Hammer]] +1 · Ch 2: Kiroc's [[item:Horsekiller Bow]] +1, Jester's [[item:Cleansing Blade]] +1

partII.text: Bring all 15: Part II deploys up to 15, so the bench fights from Ch 1
detail: Dietrich, Fabio, Esmeralda, Mikaela, Yang Jie, Io, Kiroc, Jester
Olympia, Goliath, Simon, Dante, Ursula, Catania, Gaitz

partII.text: Cover the Part II roles: physical tanks, magic tanks, long range for shields, Physic, fliers
detail: Physical: Esmeralda, Goliath, Gaitz, Simon · Magic: Fabio, Olympia, the Bishops
Long range: Kiroc, Jester, Ursula, Fabio, Olympia, Esmeralda's thrown spears
Physic: Yang Jie, Olympia · Archers vs fliers: Kiroc, Jester, Ursula · Flier: Catania

partII.text: Part II Ch 2: send Catania after the southeast Ranger before he flees on Turn 4
Blessings for Part II: Aurora, then Kalla to Lv 3, Smyrnos to Lv 2; Credna is the weakest
detail: Smyrnos Lv 2 gives magic Rng +1: Fabio and Olympia poke 2x2 armored units without a counter

extra.text: Pack every unit's Part II kit before the Mars battle: main weapon in hand, at most 6 items
detail: Only what a unit holds carries in (the game says "equipped"; read here as its own 6 items?)
Each unit's Ch 12 stage lists the 6; pack benched units too
Elixir on Dietrich and the tanks, a Concoction on everyone: Part II Ch 3 asks for plenty

extra.text: Hand Dietrich's [[item:Silver Sword]] to Jester before Mars: it is Jester's Part II sword
detail: A Dew takes the slot in Dietrich's duel kit

extra.text: Keep extra weight at 3 or less on Dietrich, Jester, Kiroc and the archers; only armor wears a mask
detail: The [[item:Charm Mask]] waits in storage for Gaitz in Part III

extra.text: Take My Late Sister's Accessory if it appears: no Creek in Part II Ch 2 without it, so no Nathan
Clear all 8 Paralogues: Talimun's, Anatolia's, Orchel's and Bertrand's feed Part III joins
Beat Il-Lara and Oko, finish 10 Combat Art boosts: Guardian, Ranger, Blacksmith carry over
Divine classes take one holder each: plan The Blade for Dietrich, The Eternal for Simon
